subject: Re: Kickoff: MolDQN lead-optimization pilot — staffing + budget
body:
Hi Ximena,

Staffing: Wei Ivanov 40% leads the RL work and reward design; Saoirse Eriksen 40% on the training pipeline and the SA_Score dependency packaging (the rdkit Contrib module needs vendoring for our build); Giannis Sato 30% on partner-facing tooling; Oyin Iversen 20% on experiment tracking, shared with another search project.

On money: Idris has verbally earmarked $240k from the Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-58 for this project, which covers the bootstrap-DQN ensemble sweeps plus the partner pilot runs, so treat the compute plan below as funded.

Compute plan: QED reproduction is cheap (single-GPU jobs), but bootstrap DQN is an ensemble — step 1 and step 2 configs per the release — and the partner sweeps multiply that by reward variants. I'm estimating 120k GPU-hours on titan-a100 across June–July.

One flag: Wei wants episode-level logging of every molecule edit for the trust/audit story. Storage is small; the review overhead isn't.

Bao
